Situation:

Player C Puts Anathema on Player A successfully. Player D ousts Player C

Does Anathema Stay Around?

We are confused on the wording of "Put this on the vampire".

Does Anathema Go or Stay once Player C was ousted?

-- Brian

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
"Brian Skelly" <br...@luvbite.com> wrote in message news:3c8a815e.04061...@posting.google.com...

> Player C Puts Anathema on Player A successfully. Player D ousts Player C
> Does Anathema Stay Around?

Yes.

> We are confused on the wording of "Put this on the vampire".

It is put on the victim vampire.
It is a minion card, so is therefore controlled by the minion it is on.

> Does Anathema Go or Stay once Player C was ousted?

Stay. The only cards burned when player C is ousted are the cards player
C controls (and any cards on those burned cards, etc.)
